// 1. SDT serialization and deserialization
        &Item = new()
        &Item.Code = 100
        &Item.Name = "Widget"
        &ItemJson = &Item.ToJson()
        Print(&ItemJson)

        // 2. Clear item and deserialize back
        &NewItem = new()
        &NewItem.FromJson(&ItemJson)
        Print(&NewItem.Code)
        Print(&NewItem.Name)

        // 3. Partial update with case-insensitivity
        &PartialJson = '{"code": 200}'
        &NewItem.FromJson(&PartialJson)
        Print(&NewItem.Code)
        Print(&NewItem.Name)

        // 4. Collection serialization
        &Col = new()
        &Item1 = new()
        &Item1.Code = 1
        &Item1.Name = "Alpha"
        &Col.Add(&Item1)

        &Item2 = new()
        &Item2.Code = 2
        &Item2.Name = "Beta"
        &Col.Add(&Item2)

        &ColJson = &Col.ToJson()
        Print(&ColJson)

        // 5. Collection deserialization
        &NewCol = new()
        &NewCol.FromJson(&ColJson)
        Print(&NewCol.Count)
        Print(&NewCol.Item(1).Name)
        Print(&NewCol.Item(2).Name)

&Items = new()
        &Item1 = new()
        &Item1.Code = 10
        &Item1.Name = "alpha"
        &Items.Add(&Item1)

        &Item2 = new()
        &Item2.Code = 20
        &Item2.Name = "beta"
        &Items.Add(&Item2)

        &Item3 = new()
        &Item3.Code = 30
        &Item3.Name = "gamma"
        &Items.Add(&Item3)

        // Count and IndexOf
        Print(&Items.Count)
        Print(&Items.IndexOf(&Item2))

        // Insert at 1
        &ItemFirst = new()
        &ItemFirst.Code = 1
        &ItemFirst.Name = "first"
        &Items.Add(&ItemFirst, 1)

        Print(&Items.Count)
        Print(&Items.IndexOf(&ItemFirst))
        Print(&Items.IndexOf(&Item2))

        // For in loop iterating items
        For &Item in &Items
            Print(&Item.Code)
            Print(&Item.Name)
        EndFor

        // For in loop with Exit
        For &Item in &Items
            If &Item.Code = 10
                Exit
            EndIf
            Print(&Item.Code)
        EndFor

        // Remove item at 1
        &Items.Remove(1)
        Print(&Items.Count)

        // Clear
        &Items.Clear()
        Print(&Items.Count)

                    msg("eom_day=" + &Dt2.Day().ToString(), status)
                    &Dt2 = ResetTime(&Dt)
                    msg("reset_hour=" + &Dt2.Hour().ToString(), status)

                    // AddYr, AddMth, AddDays, TAdd

                    &Dt2 = AddMth(&Dt, 1)

                    msg("dadd_month=" + &Dt2.Month().ToString(), status)
                    &Dt2 = TAdd(&Dt, 60)
                    msg("tadd_minute=" + &Dt2.Minute().ToString(), status)

                    // Methods: AddYears, AddMonths, AddDays, AddHours, AddMinutes, AddSeconds
                    &Dt2 = &Dt.AddYears(1)
                    msg("addyears_day=" + &Dt2.Day().ToString(), status)
                    &Dt2 = &Dt.AddMonths(1)
                    msg("addmonths_month=" + &Dt2.Month().ToString(), status)
                    &Dt2 = &Dt.AddDays(2)
                    msg("adddays_month=" + &Dt2.Month().ToString(), status)
                    &Dt2 = &Dt.AddHours(2)
                    msg("addhours_hour=" + &Dt2.Hour().ToString(), status)
                    &Dt2 = &Dt.AddMinutes(15)
                    msg("addminutes_min=" + &Dt2.Minute().ToString(), status)
                    &Dt2 = &Dt.AddSeconds(30)
                    msg("addsec_sec=" + &Dt2.Second().ToString(), status)

                    // DDiff, TDiff, Age
                    &D2 = YMDToD(2024, 2, 28)
                    &Num = DDiff(&D, &D2)
                    msg("ddiff=" + &Num.ToString(), status)
                    &Num = &Dt.Difference(&Dt2)
                    msg("diff_has_val=" + (&Num > 0).ToString(), status)
                    
                    &D2 = YMDToD(2000, 5, 15)
                    &D = YMDToD(2024, 5, 15)
                    &Num = Age(&D2, &D)
                    msg("age_fn=" + &Num.ToString(), status)
                    &Num = &D2.Age(&D)
                    msg("age_method=" + &Num.ToString(), status)
